gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-mono: Every stroke is cut to one width, vintage and showy. Noto Sans Mono sits beneath it as a plain sans with sturdy, tall lowercase and spacing that never lets letters touch.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-mro: Vast Shadow draws each letter with a single, unswelling line. Noto Sans Mro follows with dense, tall-bodied words and wide entrances into each letter, so a long passage would feel sturdy yet easy to enter.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-multani: Vintage and showy, Vast Shadow has no calligraphic shading. Noto Sans Multani handles the quiet work instead, a plain sans with a lofty x-height and an e whose terminal gapes wide, while the heading simply catches the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Retro and loud, with round letters as heavy as the straight ones. Noto Sans Myanmar, a plain sans, runs a thick, dense band of text with a broad c, so a longer passage would read clean and weighty.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Its lowercase stands almost cap-tall, with wide-open s curves. Vast Shadow is best at holding its line width through every turn as a vintage display; Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif, is best at tall, clear text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Eye-catching from the first glance, Vast Shadow gives every stroke the same visual weight. Beneath it, Noto Sans Nag Mundari, a plain sans, lets its half-unwrapped c and s shapes and capital-rivaling lowercase carry the text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads as approachable, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Vast Shadow's strokes look like fine rope, while this sans-serif keeps openings generous at every weight, so a longer passage stays inviting.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa keeps its lowercase e clearly open. Vast Shadow's rope-thin outline has no thick or thin parts, and that vintage touch sits well against this plain sans with tall counters and bowls.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu holds its terminals far from the stroke body, with a towering x-height. And Vast Shadow gives vintage display, its n arches as thick as the stems, while this sans handles the reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Vast Shadow lays a flat, unswelling line along every curve. Noto Sans Ogham, a plain sans, answers with wide gaps in the e and tall bodies that look bold, giving the vintage heading a clean partner.
